ground_truth: The new lexer regexes for raw blocks require at least one whitespace character after `{%`: `_raw_start_re` uses `\s+` before comment/verbatim, and the end regexes use `[^\S\n]+` before endcomment/endverbatim. Django accepts tags written without spaces, e.g. `{%comment%}`, `{%verbatim%}` and `{%endverbatim%}`. Those are no longer recognized as raw-block delimiters, so their contents are tokenized and parsed as template code (wrong output or TemplateSyntaxError). Fixed by changing `+` to `*`.
